title: ERC Funded PhD Position in Theoretical Physics (High-Frequency Gravitational Waves)
institution: Institut de Física d'Altes Energies (IFAE), Theory Division
about: IFAE's Theory Division in Barcelona offers an ERC-funded PhD position on theory for high-frequency gravitational-wave searches, with a flexible start between spring and fall 2027. Applications are due 15 January 2027.
